info.title: aadhar.sh public API
info.summary: Keyless, read-only JSON endpoints on aadhar.sh.
info.description: The public HTTP API of aadhar.sh, Aadharsh Pannirselvam's personal site. Every endpoint is read-only and needs no key, account or signup: production is the sandbox. Errors are JSON with at least an `error` sentence (see the Error schema). The same capabilities are tools on the MCP server at https://aadhar.sh/mcp. Guide: https://aadhar.sh/developers.

tags.name: photos
tags.description: The photo archive and its Fuji recipes.

tags.name: around
tags.description: The crawled neighborhood of venture firm homepages.

get.description: Lexical search over the public pages, writing, garage notes and utility descriptions. Use it to find a page by topic before fetching that page's Markdown twin.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search terms. Stopwords are dropped and at most 12 terms are used.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum results. Values outside the range are clamped, and a non-number falls back to the default.

get.description: NLWeb's REST endpoint over the same corpus as /search.json, ranked by the Clef decision model with a lexical fallback. Pass streaming=0 for one JSON body; the protocol's default is a server-sent event stream. Results are ranked pages with extractive descriptions: this origin runs no generative model, so it never writes an answer. Clef ranking is limited to 20 questions per caller per minute, after which ranking falls back to lexical and _meta.ranking says so.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The question.

parameters.name: streaming
parameters.description: 0, false, no or off returns one JSON body. Any other value, or none, streams text/event-stream.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Only list is served. summarize and generate return 501 with supported_modes.

parameters.name: site
parameters.description: The only site is aadhar.sh.

parameters.name: top_k
parameters.description: Maximum results. `limit` is read when top_k is absent.

parameters.name: prev
parameters.description: Earlier queries in the conversation, comma-separated, at most 10.

parameters.name: decontextualized_query
parameters.description: If present, this string is searched instead of query.

parameters.name: query_id
parameters.description: Echoed back. A UUID is generated when absent.

200.description: One JSON body when streaming=0, otherwise an NLWeb event stream.

400.description: query is missing, or site or mode is unknown.

post.summary: Ask with an NLWeb v0.55 body
post.description: The NLWeb v0.55 dialect: a JSON body whose query is an object selects it, and streaming answers use named start, result and complete events. Body fields win over query-string fields.

200.description: One JSON body when prefer.streaming is false, otherwise named server-sent events.

400.description: The body is not JSON, or a field is invalid.

405.description: A method other than GET, POST or HEAD.

get.description: Filter the published photo archive by caption, camera, lens, film simulation, Fuji recipe or date. Returned EXIF is a public-safe allowlist, and every Fuji frame carries the recipe it was shot with.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Caption search; the only ranked field.

parameters.name: camera
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring of the camera.

parameters.name: lens
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring of the lens.

parameters.name: film
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring of the film simulation.

parameters.name: recipe
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring anywhere in the recipe card, for example DR400.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Earliest date, YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Latest date, YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size. Values outside the range are clamped, and a non-number falls back to the default.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Rows to skip.

get.summary: Inspect how a machine reads a URL
get.description: Fetch one public URL server-side as AadharshBot and return what a machine sees: status, headers, structured data, the token cost of the HTML, per-bot robots verdicts, discovery surfaces and an agent-readiness score. Shares a 30 per minute per-caller budget with /mcp and the terminal tools.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The public http or https URL. https:// is assumed when no scheme is given. Ports other than 80 and 443, credentials, and private or link-local hosts are refused.

parameters.name: phases
parameters.description: page limits the scan to fields derived from the page itself (one subrequest).

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: cloudflare returns the Cloudflare Agent Readiness level instead of the full observation.

400.description: The URL is missing or refused.

502.description: The target timed out (8 seconds) or failed.

get.description: Inspect two public URLs and report the differences in status, content, readiness, tier and agent surfaces. Limited to 4 comparisons per caller per minute.

parameters.name: left
parameters.description: The first URL, validated like /lens/fetch.

parameters.name: right
parameters.description: The second URL.

400.description: left or right is missing or refused.

get.description: A weekly, longitudinal record of how agent-ready 16 representative sites are, with each site's score and tier over time.
The tracks on Aadharsh's current "rn" Spotify playlist, each with a song.link URL that opens in the listener's own music service. Cached for an hour.

502.description: The playlist could not be read from Spotify.

get.description: The latest AadharshBot crawl of a small list of crypto venture firm homepages: status, title, description and robots verdict for each.

503.description: No snapshot exists yet. Retry after a day.

get.summary: Read what changed in the neighborhood
get.description: A bounded history of changes between crawls of the neighborhood: status, title, description, robots and content changes. Never returns crawled page bodies.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum change records. Values outside the range are clamped, and a non-number falls back to the default.

get.description: Bookable coffee slots in New York, in the host's timezone. Fails closed: when the calendar is stale or unreachable it returns no slots. Booking happens at bookingUrl and is confirmed by hand.

503.description: The calendar is unavailable; slots is empty. Retry after 60 seconds.

405.description: A method other than GET or HEAD.

get.description: The last 30 days of identified AI-crawler visits to this site, priced at one cent a page as commentary. ok is false with a reason when analytics is not configured.
Every published photo with its thumbnail URLs, full-resolution key, size and upload date. The homepage grid draws from it.
Aadharsh Pannirselvam's resume as JSON Resume. The same content is at /resume.md and /resume.pdf.

ok.description: Always false on an error, where the endpoint uses an ok flag.

error.description: A sentence describing what went wrong, for a person or an agent to read.

code.description: A stable machine token, where the endpoint sets one: not_found, method_not_allowed, storage_unavailable.

status.description: The HTTP status, repeated in the body.

suggestions.description: Absolute URLs of the closest real pages, on a 404.

parameter.description: The query parameter that was rejected (/ask).

Error.description: The site's error shape. Every JSON endpoint answers its errors in JSON with at least `error`. Endpoints may add their own fields (for example /ask echoes `query_id` and `results`, /rn/tracks keeps `tracks: []`).

score.description: 0-100. With Clef ranking, the probability Clef puts on this page.

schema_object.description: A schema.org node for the result.

ranking.description: Which ranker ran: Clef, or lexical with the reason.

AskResponse.description: NLWeb /ask answer, returned as one JSON body when streaming=0.

metadata.description: Public-safe EXIF and Fuji recipe fields that are present for this frame (camera, lens, aperture, shutter, iso, focal, date, film, dr, grain, recipe and others). Absent fields are omitted, never guessed.

matched.description: Terms that matched, when q was given.

query.description: The normalized filters, empty strings when absent.

LensObservation.description: One public URL as a machine reads it. The page-derived fields are always present; discovery, wire, terms, agent, botViews and readiness appear when the discovery pass ran. With mode=cloudflare the body is the Cloudflare Agent Readiness level instead.

song_link_url.description: A song.link forwarder to the listener's own music service.

error.description: Present, with an empty tracks list, when no playlist is set.
